review_method: Read all 160 final rows, all 90 unique supplied evidence blocks, and all 40 held-out frozen question/fact records. Labels assess semantic support and necessary conditions independently of verifier verdicts or lexical regex. Compound frozen facts require their substantive clauses; notes identify overinclusive gold facts and controlled-deletion semantic leakage.
